decision.observation: 0 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The car is off the gravel on the grass verge, nose against the white rail fence, with the road running diagonally down-left. A pine trunk is immediately to its left.
decision.hypothesis: Steering at 15 mph killed all momentum and the car slid into the fence. It is nose-on to the fence, so S-only reverse is the shortest disengage before driving back across the grass onto the gravel to the lower-left.
decision.memory: W+A at 15 mph cost all 15 mph — the harsh steering rule now has a worst case. From a fence pin, S-only reverse is the standard escape.
